Lane w11b-gemini-adapter (arm G; D8 sections 1 and 3, D8:461-472; ruling Q-3): GeminiAdapter, agent_adapter's interface for gemini: one `gemini -p <line> -o stream-json` per turn through box/run_take.run_turn, `-m <model>` and the pinned mode's `--approval-mode yolo` on every call, no sandbox flag, `-r <session id>` after the first turn only (the id read from turn 1's init; a later init naming another session refused), the version from `gemini --version`; read_stream maps the documented events into the seam's records (api_errors from error events and failed results only, never the agent's text; agent output from assistant messages with words and tool_use only; stats as recorded, a missing count refused, never 0), checks init.model and every key of result.stats.models against the row's model on every turn, maps exit codes 0, 1, 42, 53 (53 never end_turn) and refuses any other; the TurnResult's init is None because the stream records no permission mode (Q-w11b-2). SHAPES_SOURCE = documented, reported in the harness record and every turn record. Not registered in any seam table (a later seam slice). Live harness 3a (edit without transfer, under glitch-06's step-3 order, 14 Oct 2026): the exec is kept in executed_turns before the stream is read; the read and resumed-session check moved verbatim into _read_turn; a refusal after the exec is ExecutedStreamRefused (a StreamError and an agent_adapter.ExecutedTurnRefused); bound by tests/test_executed_turn_refusal.py. Live harness 3b: turn_identity states each pin field's source (stream-init or stream-stats model, version-exec version, submitted-argv mode); init stays None. Live harness 3c: native_session_path locates the resumed session file by turn 1's session id (appended after _end; no line above moved). 3b review fold: submitted_mode reads the mode only from the turn's actual-submission journal argv (unobserved without one), never the pin. Review nit 3: any other exception after the exec becomes a plain ExecutedTurnRefused (a defect, never a StreamError). Batch-8 review finding 5 (live harness): the journal expectation names 'first-turn' on turn 1 and the session afterwards (same line), matching vendor_provenance.launch_facts' turn-1 rule. Lane vendor-admission round-2 ruling 2 (glitch-b5, 16 Oct 2026), an edit without transfer: the SHAPES_SOURCE paragraph of the docstring (lines 13-14) now says freeze.py refuses a design row of this harness (arm G) while SHAPES_SOURCE is not "recorded" (T3), in place of "owed to a later slice"; no code changed. Bound by tests/test_freeze_shapes.py FS-docs. Lane vendor-b24 (glitch-26's rulings B24-2, 21 Oct 2026, under Javier's standing delegation): READ_SHAPES is box/od57_shapes.GEMINI (the shapes moved there, with grep_search added).
